SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_keys, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_ids, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) ids, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) sl
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_web, w.status AS wstatus, w.dispatch_date IS NULL AS nodisp
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, false, NULL, false
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales),2) net, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_web THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines, SUM(CASE WHEN n.nodisp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nodisp, SUM(CASE WHEN n.is_web AND n.wstatus NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) odd_status
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) net FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26') AND r.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store, m.net mine, c.net ctl, ROUND(COALESCE(m.net,0)-COALESCE(c.net,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.net,0)-COALESCE(c.net,0))>0.5 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
per_cat AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year,
           CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN 'Electrical' ELSE cp.category END AS category,
           SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
           SUM(CASE WHEN cp.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' AND cp.category='Garden' THEN n.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS reassigned
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period=8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT ty.category, 8 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2024_25, ROUND(ty.net_sales,2) AS net_sales_fy2025_26,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),2) AS growth_pct, ROUND(ly.reassigned,2) re_ly, ROUND(ty.reassigned,2) re_ty
FROM per_cat ty JOIN per_cat ly ON ly.category=ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND ty.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
ORDER BY 1
